extension.description: The statistics in this table are published quarterly. To smooth seasonal effects, each quarter refers to the online job advertisements published during that quarter and the three preceding quarters (e.g. data points for TIME=2023-Q3 refer to the period from Q4 2022 to Q3 2023).
